_about: Inputs for research/monorace/gatenet_flops.py. Every value is either quoted from arXiv:2601.15222v1 (field `reported`) or an explicit modelling assumption (field `assumed`). Provenance for each is in research/monorace.md.

gatenet.input_channels_basis: assumed: an RGB IMX219 rolling-shutter camera with HSV colour augmentation in training implies a 3-channel input; the paper does not state the channel count
gatenet.channels_basis: reported: the encoder/decoder/outputs diagram in the GateNet Network subsection, with f=4
gatenet.conv_kernel_basis: reported: 'Each block consists of double 3x3 convolutional layers with batch normalization and ReLU'
gatenet.upsample_basis: assumed: 'a transposed convolution' with no kernel size given; 2x2 stride-2 is the standard channel-preserving choice and is the assumption the dataset's Swift row already uses
gatenet.skip_mode_basis: reported: 'followed by adding the skip connections from the corresponding encoder layer'
gatenet.output_heads_basis: reported: 'outc-1 denotes a 1x1 convolution mapping to a single output channel'; deployment uses only the highest-resolution map y4, and the other four heads together are 0.03% of the network
gatenet.call_rate_basis: reported: images captured at 90 Hz and cropped to 384x384 'to reduce computational load and enable real-time processing on the Jetson Orin NX at 90 Hz'; Fig. 5 labels the segmentation branch 90 Hz

gcnet.layer_widths_basis: reported: 'a three-layer fully connected network with ReLU activation functions and 64 neurons per layer'; 'The policy takes in 24 observations'; four motor commands out. Fig. 5 draws the input as 20, which is also what the listed observation components sum to; the difference moves the total by 3e-6 relative
gcnet.call_rate_basis: reported: 'This small network runs on the flight controller at 500 Hz'

race.ai_time_basis: reported: Fig. 1D organizer VTx RF timing, semi-final heat 6, MAVLAB M16; the paper's own onboard state-estimation timing for the same run is 16.56 s
race.human_basis: reported: Fig. 1D organizer VTx RF timing across the quarter-finals, semi-finals, final and runner-up heats; VICENT recorded no completion
race.unit_basis: reported: 'The objective was to complete two laps in minimal time' and 'the completion time as the interval from the first passage of Gate 1 to the second passage of Gate 11'

scenarios.skip_mode_concat: concatenate the encoder skip onto the channel-preserving transposed-convolution output, doubling the first convolution's input channels in every decoder block
